build_CenterNetHead: build a CenterNetHead instance with in_channels, feat_channels, and num_classes for object detection
forward_CenterNetHead: run forward pass on feature tensors through CenterNetHead to get heatmap, wh, and offset predictions
loss_by_feat_CenterNetHead: compute CenterNetHead losses including center heatmap, wh, and offset loss from predictions and ground truth
predict_by_feat_CenterNetHead: transform CenterNetHead heatmap predictions into bounding box results with scores and labels
get_targets_CenterNetHead: generate Gaussian heatmap targets and wh/offset targets from ground truth bounding boxes and labels
